extension.description: Add any number of Stremio addon manifests and browse their catalogs, metadata, streams and subtitles from inside Kodi.
extension.disclaimer: This add-on provides no content. You are responsible for the Stremio addons you install and the content they provide.
extension.news: v0.11.0 - New stream page: cards with badges, filter chips, no logos. Extended info for episodes. Selecting can open Extended info for episodes too. Fixed context menu entries overwriting each other, and settings buttons on Fire TV. v0.10.3 - With autoplay on: "Show Playable Streams" in context menus and a Streams tile in Extended info. Removing an episode from Continue Watching also removes its show from Next Up until you watch more. v0.10.2 - Continue Watching shows descriptions, cast and details. v0.10.1 - Create, rename and remove hubs (Organise catalogs context menu); settings buttons open reliably. v0.10.0 - Hubs (Movies, TV Shows, Anime, More) with Genres; Organise catalogs; tidy names; poster tiles. v0.9.0 - Widgets folder, combined Continue Watching, time left, show progress, hide watched, pre-warming, open on next episode. v0.8.7 - Actor/director searches: AIOMetadata people search when enabled, otherwise Cinemeta added. v0.8.6 - Extended info: icon action tiles; one-line scrolling detail rows. v0.8.5 - Settings shortcut to show/hide Kodi's ".." entry.

extension.summary: Search your library, Stremio Bridge and Spotify at once
extension.description: Type a search and see results from your Kodi library, Stremio Bridge's search catalogs and Spotify (music and podcasts) in one page of rows. Put RunScript(script.shiggsy365.globalsearch) on any menu item or button to open it.

extension.summary: Keep Kodi's artwork cache and add-on downloads small
extension.description: Every few days, removes cached artwork Kodi hasn't shown recently and the add-on zips Kodi keeps after installing. Kodi downloads any artwork it needs again. Made for low-storage devices like Fire TV Sticks.
Kodi repository for shiggsy365's add-ons, including Stremio Bridge. Updates install automatically.
